annotations.title: Life euerlaſting.
annotations.text: Both the life of glorie in heauen, and of grace here in the Church, conſiſteth in the knowledge of God: ◦ that, in perfect viſion: this, in faith working by charitie. for, knowledge of God without keeping his commaundements, is not true knowledge, that is to ſay, it is an vnprofitable knowledge. 1 Io. 2.

annotations.title: Sanctifie them.
annotations.text: <mn>◦</mn> Chriſt prayeth that the Apoſtles, their ſucceſſors, & al that ſhal be of their beleefe, may be ſanctified in truth. Which is as much to ſay, as to deſire that the Church may euer haue the Spirit of truth, and be free from errour. Which praier of Chriſt had not been heard, if the Church might erre.

annotations.title: But for them.
annotations.text: He expreſſeth (and it is a great comfort) that he praieth not onely for the Apoſtles, but for the whole Church after them, <mn>◦</mn> that is, for al beleeuers. And al this profound and diuine praier is reſembled in the holy Canon of the Maſſe before the conſecration, as here it was made before his viſible Sacrifice on the croſſe.
